scope: Per-lane Baozi B1 median compared to the unchanged B0 corpus, precision, endpoint, IO and build policy. Assimp is a control, not the regression target.
policy: B0 median + max(3 * B0 IQR, measurement floor). Floors: 1000 ns for time and 4096 bytes for GNU time RSS. Breaches require attribution; retain raw outliers, do not delete or replace B0.
noisy_time_policy: B0 relative IQR above 0.25 is descriptive: repeat the same lane without replacing B0 before attributing a median breach to source changes. Process RSS is never a stage peak.
